chunks: He said: And Abu Muhammad al-Sayrafi narrated to me from Abdul Karim ibn Amr from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said: I heard him say:

As if I can see this son of mine, meaning Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), having been taken by the sons of so-and-so [the Abbasids], and he remained in their hands for a period and a long time. Then he was released from their hands, and he takes the hand of a man from his progeny until he brings him to Mount Radwa.

key_terms.بَنُو فُلَانٍ: The sons of so-and-so (referring to the Abbasids)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the detention and release of Imam Musa al-Kadhim?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the prophetic foresight of Imam al-Sadiq regarding the prolonged imprisonment of Imam Musa al-Kadhim by the Abbasids, a key event in establishing the Imamate's endurance under political pressure. The mention of Mount Radwa serves as a significant geographical and spiritual landmark, often associated with the gathering of tribes and divine decree, symbolizing the transition of authority to a specific descendant. This narration is frequently cited in Shia scholarship to refute the Waqifiya (those who stopped believing in the Imamate after a specific Imam) by demonstrating the continuous line of Imams.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 47 - Narrated to me Abu Muhammad Sairafi from Abdul Karim bin Amr from Abu Basir that he said: I heard Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) say:

As if I can see this son, Abul Hasan, apprehended by Bani so and so [Bani Abbas] and is under their arrest for a long time. Then he is released and he holds the hand of a person from his progeny so that they may convey him to Mount Razawi.
